svg.title: Hard-margin and soft-margin SVMs on data with one outlier
svg.desc: The same separable two-class data with one extra positive point placed close to the negatives. Left: the hard-margin separator tilts sharply to squeeze between the outlier and the negatives, leaving a narrow margin, far from where it sits without the outlier, drawn dotted. Right: with a soft margin and C equal to 0.1 the separator lies almost on top of its outlier-free position, and the outlier simply sits inside the margin.
